svg.text: ESP32 DevKit V1 + 2x VL53L5CX + Grove 3-axis accelerometer + 2x ELEGOO DC vibration motors - matches firmware/include/config.h
I2C pull-ups: on the breakout boards
ELEGOO DC motors with an off-centre weight
All VIN 5 V symbols are the same net (board VIN = USB 5 V).
All GND symbols are the same net.
Sensors run from 3V3; motors from VIN through the transistors.
Both VL53L5CX boot at 0x29: the LPn wires are required.
Mounting (DATA REPORT v3): pod 0.72 m from the tip of a
130 cm cane; ground ToF 19 deg, forward ToF 73 deg above
the shaft axis. Battery sense: none (power bank).
Motors: PWM 20 kHz; right motor starts 50 ms after the left
